arxiv-2110-06999.title: Study of positional encoding approaches for audio spectrogram transformers
arxiv-2110-06999.creator: Leonardo Pepino Pablo Riera Luciana Ferrer
arxiv-2110-06999.description: Abstract Transformers have revolutionized the world of deep learning, specially in the field of natural language processing. Recently, the Audio Spectrogram Transformer (AST) was proposed for audio classification, leading to state of the art results in several datasets. However, in order for ASTs to outperform CNNs, pretraining with ImageNet is needed.

arxiv-2311-11228.title: A Universal Framework for Accurate and Efficient Geometric Deep Learning of Molecular Systems
arxiv-2311-11228.creator: Shuo Zhang, Yang Liu, Lei Xie
arxiv-2311-11228.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Shuo Zhang, Yang Liu, Lei Xie. Molecular sciences address a wide range of problems involving molecules of different types and sizes and their complexes. Recently, geometric deep learning, especially Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), has shown promising performance in molecular science applications. However, most existing works often impose targeted inductive biases to a specific molecular system, and are inefficient when applied to macromolecules or large-scale tasks, thereby limiting their applications to many real-world problems.

arxiv-2410-04682.title: On the Adversarial Risk of Test Time Adaptation: An Investigation into Realistic Test-Time Data Poisoning
arxiv-2410-04682.creator: Yongyi Su, Yushu Li, Nanqing Liu, Kui Jia, Xulei Yang, Chuan-Sheng Foo, Xun Xu
arxiv-2410-04682.description: Abstract Test-time adaptation (TTA) updates the model weights during the inference stage using testing data to enhance generalization. However, this practice exposes TTA to adversarial risks. Existing studies have shown that when TTA is updated with crafted adversarial test samples, also known as test-time poisoned data, the performance on benign samples can deteriorate.

arxiv-2505-24290.title: Two-color harmonic spectroscopy of ultrafast Dirac electron dynamics
arxiv-2505-24290.creator: Zhaopin Chen, Camilo Granados, Eyal Uzner, Ido Nisim, Daniel Kroeger, Ofer Neufeld, Marcelo F. Ciappina, Michael Krüger
arxiv-2505-24290.description: Abstract High-harmonic generation (HHG), the hallmark effect of attosecond science, is a nonperturbative nonlinear process leading to the emission of high-harmonic light from gases and solids. In gases, extreme driving laser pulse intensities can deplete the ground state, suppressing harmonic emission during the trailing edge of the pulse.

pmc-11516150.title: Exploring the dynamics of alcohol use, poverty and the role of social context in Athens, Greece
pmc-11516150.creator: S Kyriakidou, C Temenos, C Henry, T Paparrigopoulos, K Triantafyllou
pmc-11516150.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundA body of research conducted across diverse national context, including the United Kingdom, Russia, Denmark and Norway, shows a robust link between poverty and increased alcohol related harm, even after accounting for different drinking patterns.

pmc-12554191.title: 3-acetyl-11-keto-β-boswellic acid and chitosan-Ag nanoparticles for synergistic tumor-resident bacteria mediated prostate cancer therapy
pmc-12554191.creator: Bo Zou, Xuefei Tian, Ruisong Gao, Hongping Long, Yan Long, Bin Liu, Qing Zhou
pmc-12554191.description: Intratumoral bacteria play a critical role in prostate cancer (PCa) progression by altering the tumor microenvironment. Modulating these bacterial populations can significantly enhance the effectiveness of cancer therapies, including chemotherapy and immunotherapy. However, the use of antibiotics often yields inconsistent results due to poor targeting and the potential for bacterial resistance.

pmc-12616912.title: Prevalence of potentially inappropriate medications in people living with HIV: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-12616912.creator: Mustapha Muhammed Abubakar, Abdulmuminu Isah, Ruth Jeminiwa, Ibraheem Abioye, Ismaeel Yunusa, Mohammed Abba-Aji, Osagie Kenneth Cole, Jamila Sani, Mukhtar Ijaiya, Chukwuemeka Nwachuya, Yusuf Ibrahim, Mustapha Usman, Duke Daniels, Oluwaseun Samuel Ilugbuhi, Blessing Onyinye Ukoha-Kalu
pmc-12616912.description: BackgroundPotentially inappropriate medications (PIM) are associated with adverse health outcomes. The use of PIM among persons living with HIV (PLHIV) could be more problematic due to peculiarities such as antiretroviral toxicity and drug-disease interactions. However, PIM among PLHIV continues to receive little attention. Therefore, we aimed to systematically review and estimate the prevalence of PIM among PLHIV.

pmc-12651027.title: Identification of Risk Factors in Patients with Recurrent Cystitis May Improve Individualized Management
pmc-12651027.creator: Jakhongir F. Alidjanov, Ulugbek A. Khudaybergenov, Khurshid B. Khudayberdiev, Jennifer Kranz, Laila Schneidewind, Fabian P. Stangl, José Medina-Polo, Adrian Pilatz, Tommaso Cai, Kurt G. Naber, Florian M. Wagenlehner, Truls E. Bjerklund Johansen
pmc-12651027.description: Background/Objectives: Management of acute episodes of lower urinary tract infection (LUTI) depends on whether they are sporadic or recurrent. We aimed to define factors that differentiate patients with acute sporadic cystitis (AC) from those with recurrent cystitis (RC) and thereby improve individualized care. Methods: We performed a post hoc analysis of prospectively collected data from the multinational GPIU.COM study.

pmc-12666564.title: A β-lactamase inhibitory protein mutant displays high potency and a broad inhibition profile due to an altered binding mode with β-lactamases
pmc-12666564.creator: Paola Rivera, Shuo Lu, Dignite Ngango, Banumathi Sankaran, Bidadi Venkataram Prasad, Timothy Palzkill
pmc-12666564.description: β-lactamase enzymes inactivate β-lactam antibiotics, leading to drug resistance. The β-lactamase inhibitory protein (BLIP) is a naturally occurring inhibitor of β-lactamases, with inhibition constants (Ki) ranging from picomolar to micromolar values. For example, BLIP inhibits CTX-M-14 β-lactamase with a Ki of 330 nM, whereas the Ki for CTX-M-15 is 3 nM, despite CTX-M-14 and CTX-M-15 sharing 83% sequence identity.

pmc-12800287.title: Transcranial direct current stimulation of the occipitotemporal cortex enhances identification of ambiguous faces
pmc-12800287.creator: Seyed Javad Saghravanian, Hossein Esteky
pmc-12800287.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Transcranial direct current stimulation (tDCS) has emerged as a promising tool for investigating the neural mechanisms underlying various brain functions and for enhancing related behavioral performance. In this sham-controlled, between-subjects study, we examined the effects of tDCS applied to the right and left occipitotemporal cortex (OTC) on face identification performance using a delayed match-to-sample task with morphed face images of varying discrimination difficulty.

pmc-12837454.title: Dynamic Changes in Jackfruit (Artocarpus heterophyllus Lam.) Polyphenols During Maturation and In Vitro Digestion and Their Effects on the Gut Microbiota
pmc-12837454.creator: Liru Ma, Zhen Feng, Chao Zhang, Chunhe Gu, Yihong Bao
pmc-12837454.description: Jackfruit (Artocarpus heterophyllus Lam.) phenolic compounds are chemically diverse. Previous studies have predominantly focused on easily extractable free polyphenols, with limited attention on bound (conjugated) polyphenols. The transformation mechanisms of these polyphenols during maturation, digestion, and colonic fermentation remain unclear, limiting the full utilization of jackfruit resources.

pmc-13141923.title: Five-year fertilization alters soil microbial composition and functionality in sandy grassland
pmc-13141923.creator: Rui Zhang, Yulin Li, Xueyong Zhao, A. Allan Degen, Xinping Liu, Jie Lian, Yuqiang Li, Yalin Wu, Zhanhuan Shang
pmc-13141923.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The impacts of reclamation and fertilization of sandy grassland on soil microbial communities and functional groups related to carbon (C) and nitrogen (N) cycling are not well understood. To fill this gap, three types of fertilizers, namely, chemical fertilizer (CF), manure (M), and chemical fertilizer plus manure (CF_M), were applied annually for five years to reclaimed sandy cropland planted to maize. Nearby sandy grassland without fertilizer and maize was included as a control.

pmc-13388430.title: PLA/hydroxyapatite composite scaffolds fabricated by digital light processing for bone regeneration
pmc-13388430.creator: V J Garrido Hernández, D Sánchez Campos, C Velasco Santos, L S Villaseñor-Cerón, R Villafuerte-Segura, V Rodríguez Lugo
pmc-13388430.description: Bone tissue regeneration faces a major challenge: traditional therapies such as autografts and allografts are limited by donor site morbidity, restricted availability, and potential immune rejection. Therefore, there is a pressing need to develop synthetic scaffolds that mimic the extracellular matrix while providing adequate mechanical, morphological, and biological properties to promote osteogenesis and angiogenesis.

pmc-13503284.title: CRAFT: a 3D-printed modular design library for task-specific continuum robots
pmc-13503284.creator: Puspita Triana Dewi, Chloe Pogue, Chengnan Shentu, Andrea Gotelli, Jessica Burgner-Kahrs
pmc-13503284.description: Continuum robots offer safe and adaptive interaction through body compliance, yet this same property often limits their load-bearing capability. Addressing this design tradeoff typically requires application-specific designs with long development cycles. We introduce CRAFT, a 3D-printed modular design library for tendon-driven continuum robots that enables rapid mechanical reconfiguration to achieve task-specific stiffness and morphology.
